newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks drift narrowly in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks drift narrowly in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks drifted narrowly in early Friday morning trade while financial sector issues continued to rise, brokers said.
They added, however, that the Nikkei average would face tough going above the 18,000 threshold and gains were likely to be limited.
As of 0028 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 1.20 points or 0.01 percent at 18,094.61. June Nikkei futures added 40 to 18,120.
"Attention is focused on whether shares like Sony Corp will attract bargain hunters and if lower-priced raw material shares continue to gain," one broker said.
